diagnosis.the_defense_and_its_limit: bindings/sov/README.md says the checker answers only whether a declaration is structurally ready and never authorizes an operation, and SOV.md says CONTEXT_READY does not prove a consequential transition legal. Having chosen to refuse two of SOV.md's named prohibitions by name, admitting the other two without comment is an inconsistency rather than a scope boundary.
